description: Slim per-row campaign list for selection UIs — id, name, group_id, is_archived. Cheaper than `list_campaigns` for orgs with thousands of campaigns. Use `get_campaign(id)` after a selection to fetch full details.

archived.description: Pass true to include archived campaigns. Defaults to active-only.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default per API, typically 200).

name: list_campaigns_picker
title: List Campaigns (Picker)
